name: Lamplight
description: Light falling from a lamp overhead: a cone from the top edge with a disc at the source.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 50deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 80deg, transparent 80deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 50deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 80deg, transparent 80deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40%; top: -8%; width: 20%; height: 20%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
